x: Fastest times:- M.Freary (Bolton) 21:27(rec), J.Jackson (Nth.Staffs.) 21:51, R.Hill (Bolton) 21:53, J.Taylor(Cov.God)21:54, Gerry North (BELS) 21:57.

The field was a strong one; and our trio all ran very well to be narrowly beaten into second place for the team prize by surprise winners Wigan AC, against teams from Blackpool, Bolton, North Staffs, Longwood and Sale, etc. The race was a runaway victory for M.Freary of Bolton in the record time of 32:48.

With the Birchfield man well dropped, it must have been a shock for Laurie at the 4 miles mark to see Mike Freary of Bolton surge past and go on to clock a fantastic 26:33;the only man to beat 27 minutes on the day.

With the senior men’s National Cross Country Relay still a couple of hours away and our runners not yet on the Berry Hill Park course, Mike Freary made himself known to those putting up the Belgrave flag.
